name: cache-countdown
description: Prompt-cache meter above the input box: hit %, read/wrote/new tokens, a TTL countdown and advice; cache-expiry toasts and context-window alerts. /cache opens a detail pane; /cache setup walks through every setting.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1h on a Claude subscription / 5m otherwise) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it; any other value means auto

warnSeconds.title: Warn before expiry (s)
warnSeconds.description: Final stretch: inside these last seconds the band turns red and the countdown ticks every finalTickSeconds

tickSeconds.title: Countdown step (s)
tickSeconds.description: How often the countdown updates while more than warnSeconds is left. 60 shows '59m' and wakes once a minute; 1 shows m:ss and wakes every second

finalTickSeconds.title: Final countdown step (s)
finalTickSeconds.description: How often the countdown updates inside the last warnSeconds

compactWhenRemainingPct.title: Suggest /compact when window remaining ≤ (%)
compactWhenRemainingPct.description: Once the context window remaining is at or below this percentage, an expired cache suggests /compact (or /clear) instead of "keep going". Adapts to the model: 60 means 400k used on a 1M window, 80k on 200k

band.title: Meter row above the input box
band.description: The full meter (hit %, tokens, countdown, advice) as a row directly above the box you type in

status.title: Footer line beside your statusline
status.description: Also a short line in the footer under the input box ("cache 86% · 59m"), on its own line; your statusline is untouched

toast.title: Toast near expiry
toast.description: Toasts as the cache is about to expire, at the toastAt marks, once each per cache entry

toastAt.title: Toast at (time left)
toastAt.description: Comma-separated times left at which a toast fires, with units: 30m,15m,5m,1m or 1m,10s,5s,1s (h, m, s; a bare number is seconds). Keep marks at least 3 s apart: Claude Code drops a toast within 2 s of the previous one

contextAlertsAt.title: Context alerts at (% of window remaining)
contextAlertsAt.description: A toast each time the conversation crosses one of these fill levels of the context window, e.g. 50,25,10 → "context: 25% of window remaining". "off" disables. Independent of the cache-expiry toasts
